title: NetDerivationRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the NetDerivationRequested event (class: domain), with which submission-svc asks canonical-svc to record a derived version of an original that was not yet submitted, net of the listed credit notes (INV-REQ-558). The entity and tenant travel in the CloudEvents envelope. The CloudEvents id of the event is the idempotency key of the consumer. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

originalDocUuid.description: The Doc UUID of the original document the net version is derived from.

expectedBaseVersion.description: The version of the original the decision was taken on; canonical-svc refuses the request when the original has a newer version.

creditNotes.description: The credit notes netted into the derived version, each at the version the decision was taken on.

docUuid.description: The Doc UUID of the credit note.

version.description: The version of the credit note the decision was taken on.
